rationale: The distribution thesis remains mechanically intact — price is still ~5% below session VWAP ($42.04), below the 9-EMA ($40.34), printing lower highs with down-bars carrying heavier volume (31.5k on the markdown to $39.94 vs. 19.5k on the bounce to $40.20), and the risk-off tape plus the unfilled gap at $38.89 leaves ~1.4% of downside to the original $39.40 target. The one caution is that $39.90 has held on three tests and the newest-low bar came on thin volume (1.9k), but there is no confirmed reversal signal (no heavy absorption at the low, no EMA reclaim, no higher low), so neither closing for the current $194 profit nor flipping long against a valid short structure is justified by stronger evidence.
